messages:
maria: starting canary rollout for embed-service v2.15.0 -> 3% traffic from now. change window open for 2h. pin/backout plan: if we hit p99>250ms for 3m or 5xx > 0.5% we'll stop and pin to v2.14.1. asking Ops for stop/go at T+12m. release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2.15.0

deploy-bot: [automated] canary started id=cny-7098765432 traffic=3% policy=gradual cohorts=0,1,2

raj: watching p50/p95/p99 and error-rate. will report anomalies.

leo: seeing a small p99 spike in eu-west-1 (baseline ~90ms -> 280ms at 1:03). not widespread yet but noting it.

emily: any KV cache heatup? those can cause tail spikes on cold pods. if it stays >500ms we should hold.

maria: agreed. threshold reiterated: p99>250ms sustained 3m OR 5xx>0.5% -> stop and pin. otherwise aim to reassess at 12m.

tim: ack. Ops prepared to attenuate to 1% or rollback. prefer attenuate first to isolate cohort.

deploy-bot: metric snapshot: cpu=63% p50=45ms p99=280ms(region=eu-west-1) errors=0.07%

leo: that eu-west p99 has been >250ms for ~30s. could be cohort skew.

maya: @maria quick question — routing policy for cohorts? is cohort distribution uniform by region?

maria: it's user_id % 100. 3% maps to cohorts 0-2. looks like cohort 2 is heavier in eu-west (regional user distribution).

raj: propose we attenuate to cohorts 0-1 (2%) and drop cohort 2 to remove eu-west pressure. command: `deployctl update-canary --id cny-7098765432 --traffic 2 --cohorts 0,1`

maria: go for it, Tim.

 tim: executing attenuate command now.

deploy-bot: [action] attenuating canary id=cny-7098765432 -> traffic=2% cohorts=0,1

deploy-bot: post-attenuation snapshot: p99 eu-west-1=150ms p50 global=48ms errors=0.03%

leo: much better. will monitor for 10m to ensure stability.

emily: request: enable KV prefix prewarm on canary pool to reduce cold-tail for next ramps. suggested config:
```
kvcache:
  prewarm: true
  preheat_keys: 5000
```

tim: toggled prewarm on canary pool p-cny-7098765432.

deploy-bot: prewarm toggled=true pool=p-cny-7098765432

maria: consensus check — continue with canary at 2% and re-evaluate at T+12m. if stable then plan a 10% ramp next.

maya: +1

raj: +1

leo: +1 (monitoring)

 tim: +1

maria: ok marking this thread resolved for now. if anyone sees regressions alert @oncall and escalate. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: helper notes: rollback -> `deployctl rollback --id cny-7098765432 --target v2.14.1`; attenuate -> `deployctl attenuate --id cny-7098765432 --traffic 1`.
